item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "chmod +x src/cli.js
cp config.json /tmp/config-set-check.json
node src/cli.js --help >/tmp/help.out 2>/tmp/help.err
node src/cli.js set --dry-run /tmp/config-set-check.json service.retries 3 >/tmp/dry.out 2>/tmp/dry.err
node src/cli.js set /tmp/config-set-check.json service.retries 3 >/tmp/set.out 2>/tmp/set.err
node src/cli.js set /tmp/config-set-check.json service.retries 3 >/tmp/repeat.out 2>/tmp/repeat.err
npm test
printf '%s\\n' '--- help ---'; sed -n '1,4p' /tmp/help.out
printf '%s\\n' '--- dry ---'; cat /tmp/dry.out; printf '%s\\n' '--- set ---'; cat /tmp/set.out; printf '%s\\n' '--- repeat ---'; cat /tmp/repeat.out; printf '%s\\n' '--- file ---'; cat /tmp/config-set-check.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- stderr sizes ---'; wc -c /tmp/help.err /tmp/dry.err /tmp/set.err /tmp/repeat.err"

/bin/bash -lc "chmod +x src/cli.js
cp config.json /tmp/config-set-check.json
node src/cli.js --help >/tmp/help.out 2>/tmp/help.err
node src/cli.js set --dry-run /tmp/config-set-check.json service.retries 3 >/tmp/dry.out 2>/tmp/dry.err
node src/cli.js set /tmp/config-set-check.json service.retries 3 >/tmp/set.out 2>/tmp/set.err
node src/cli.js set /tmp/config-set-check.json service.retries 3 >/tmp/repeat.out 2>/tmp/repeat.err
npm test
printf '%s\\n' '--- help ---'; sed -n '1,4p' /tmp/help.out
printf '%s\\n' '--- dry ---'; cat /tmp/dry.out; printf '%s\\n' '--- set ---'; cat /tmp/set.out; printf '%s\\n' '--- repeat ---'; cat /tmp/repeat.out; printf '%s\\n' '--- file ---'; cat /tmp/config-set-check.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- stderr sizes ---'; wc -c /tmp/help.err /tmp/dry.err /tmp/set.err /tmp/repeat.err"

/bin/bash -lc "cp config.json /tmp/config-set-final.json
node src/cli.js set -- /tmp/config-set-final.json service.retries -1
node src/cli.js set --dry-run /tmp/config-set-final.json service.enabled true
node src/cli.js set /tmp/config-set-final.json service.retries -1
node src/cli.js set /tmp/config-set-final.json service.retries 'not-json' >/tmp/error.out 2>/tmp/error.err; status="'$?; printf '"'error_status=%s stdout_bytes=%s stderr=%s\\n' \""'$status" "$(wc -c </tmp/error.out)" "$(cat /tmp/error.err)"'
